## Hypothesis

The structure veto direction-vs-trend candidate aims to capture the edge of removing wrong-way trades by blocking P-in-uptrend and C-in-downtrend scenarios. This hypothesis is based on the idea that trend alignment is crucial for trade success.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves wiring the `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` function into the entry path, blocking P-in-uptrend and C-in-downtrend trades. This is a pure veto, removing only wrong-way trades.
